links.comparator_used: Conventional large language models (ChatGLM2-6B and LLaMA2-7B) answering without retrieval, relying on their own training knowledge
links.outcome: Semantic fidelity (ROUGE-L) and clinical correctness (accuracy) on 1,000 expert-verified nursing question-answer pairs
links.quote: For ChatGLM2-6B, ROUGE-L increased from (30.73 ± 1.48) % to (64.27 ± 0.27) %, and accuracy increased from (49.08 ± 0.92) % to (75.83 ± 0.35) %.

design_hint: retrieval grounding added to base LLMs
